verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken structure. The CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill that is almost unreadable, the legal text is microscopic, and the dark header bar survives only as a stray dark block in the top-right corner. The logo has lost its header band, the orange divider has become a tiny stray dash at top left, and the right-hand body column is cramped against the edge while the headline crowds the middle. A is slightly worse: its body copy wraps into seven ragged lines in a very narrow column. B's six lines wrap more evenly, but its leftover dark block is larger and more distracting.
